title: English Practice Quiz 0993
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: We have lived in this neighbourhood ___ 2021.
questions.explanation: Since is used with a starting point in time.

questions.question: If a person is 'hesitant', they are ___.
questions.explanation: Hesitant describes someone who pauses because they are unsure.

questions.question: The report must ___ before Friday.
questions.explanation: A modal passive uses must + be + past participle.

questions.question: Which phrase politely invites another person to speak?
options: Would you like to add anything?
questions.explanation: This phrase gives the other person a courteous opportunity to contribute.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Her instructions were very ___.
questions.explanation: Clear is the adjective needed after were.

questions.question: There is very ___ time left, so please be quick.
questions.explanation: Little is used with uncountable nouns such as time.

questions.question: Which word has the same final sound as 'wanted'?
questions.explanation: Wanted and needed end with the /ɪd/ sound.

questions.question: Which instruction is the clearest?
options: Place the signed forms in the blue folder.
questions.explanation: A clear instruction identifies the action and the exact location.

questions.question: Hardly had the show started ___ the lights went out.
